# Choose a pull request template

Replace this router with the template that matches your change:

- [Fix](https://github.com/oliver-mee/hermes-alibaba-token-plan/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/fix.md)
- [Feature](https://github.com/oliver-mee/hermes-alibaba-token-plan/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/feature.md)
- [Maintenance or documentation](https://github.com/oliver-mee/hermes-alibaba-token-plan/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/maintenance.md)

Keep the selected template's hidden `pr-template` marker. Pull requests that
retain this router or omit required validation evidence will fail PR Policy.
